overview.label: / Enterprise AI Document System
overview.description: DocPilot is an enterprise-grade AI document execution system designed for complex document workflows. From RFP ingestion to final delivery, DocPilot orchestrates multi-agent workflows to automate the entire bid response process.
overview.aiNativeDesc: Built on LangGraph multi-agent architecture with specialized agents for each workflow stage.
overview.statefulDesc: Checkpoint-backed execution with human-in-the-loop approval gates and full audit trails.
overview.enterpriseDesc: RBAC, encrypted storage, provider-agnostic LLM integration, and production-grade infrastructure.

features.label: Core Features
features.title: End-to-End Document Automation
features.description: DocPilot covers every stage of the document lifecycle, from initial ingestion to final export.
features.projectMgmtDesc: Create and manage bid projects. Each project is a self-contained workspace with its own RFP documents, knowledge base, deliverables, and review history. Search, filter, and organize across your portfolio.
features.docIngestDesc: Upload RFP documents in PDF, DOCX, or Markdown format. DocPilot automatically parses structure, extracts tables, and chunks content into searchable segments stored in MinIO.
features.reqExtractDesc: AI agents analyze the RFP and extract structured requirements: mandatory criteria, evaluation factors, compliance requirements, and submission guidelines. All requirements are linked back to source pages.
features.knowledgeDesc: The Knowledge Retriever agent uses pgvector semantic search to find the most relevant content chunks from your uploaded documents. Cosine similarity scoring ensures high-quality evidence for every section.
features.draftingDesc: The Section Drafter agent generates compliant, compelling content by combining RFP requirements with retrieved evidence. Each draft includes citations and follows your organization's tone and style guidelines.
features.qualityDesc: The Quality Reviewer agent evaluates drafts for completeness, compliance, evidence usage, and clarity. Sections below the quality threshold are automatically flagged and revised before human review.
features.approvalDesc: Critical sections pause at a human-in-the-loop gate. Reviewers can approve, request changes, or add inline comments. The workflow resumes only after explicit approval, ensuring quality control.
features.exportDesc: Export individual sections as Markdown or DOCX. Compile full deliverables with headers, formatting, and a table of contents. Version history is preserved for audit and compliance.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.title: Layered System Design
architecture.description: DocPilot follows a clean separation of concerns: Web, API, Worker, and Data layers.
architecture.webAppDesc: SPA frontend with shadcn/ui components, react-router-dom routing, and TanStack Query for server state.
architecture.apiAppDesc: REST API layer handling auth, project CRUD, document management, and WebSocket streaming for agent progress.
architecture.workerAppDesc: Async task execution with LangGraph-powered multi-agent workflows. Handles all AI processing in isolated workers.
architecture.dataServicesDesc: Persistent storage, vector search, task queuing, caching, and object storage for documents.
architecture.langgraphDesc: The Worker layer uses LangGraph to orchestrate stateful, multi-agent workflows. Each agent is a specialized node in a directed graph with checkpoint-backed execution.
